# 50+ fully remote companies that let you work from anywhere
By Rochi Zalani · May 19, 2026

But for some employees, once you go remote, you never go back. If you're nodding your head, consider these 50+ companies that are fully remote—and plan on staying that way.

## 46. Zapier
Zapier has always been remote (here's why) and currently has about 800 employees across 38 countries. Learn more about the total rewards program at Zapier.

**Note**: Due to regulatory risks, U.S. trade embargoes, financial sanctions, and security reasons, Zapier doesn't make full-time hires from these countries.
